desc:
• CHEWY GRANOLA BARS: Hearty whole grain oats and chocolate chips in a chewy bar topped with delicious chocolate flavored drizzle; Help satisfy your cravings without sacrificing taste

  • FIBER SNACKS: 9g of fiber per bar - that's 33% daily value of fiber, so you'll feel like one smart cookie when you say 'yes' to your sweet tooth; 4g of total fat per bar

  • OATS AND CHOCOLATE: Rich chocolate chips and hearty oats help satisfy your cravings without sacrificing taste

  • PANTRY AND LUNCH BOX FAVORITE: Grab and go chewy bars for an office snack, after breakfast treat, or on the go; Or pack a fiber bar with lunch

  • CONTAINS: One 14.1 oz Value Pack of Fiber One Oats and Chocolate Flavored Chewy Bars; 10 bars
features:
Features

80 Calories Per Bar
A light, portion-controlled snack that fits into most diets.

6 g Dietary Fiber (22% Daily Value)
Helps promote digestive regularity and contributes to your daily fiber needs.

Only 1 g Sugar & 5 g Net Carbs
Suitable for low-sugar and low-carb eating plans.

Made with Whole Grain Oats & Chicory Root Fiber
A blend of wholesome ingredients and prebiotic fiber for gut support.

Chocolate-Flavored with a Sweet Drizzle
Combines a chewy texture with chocolate flavor in every bite.

Value Pack Size
Typically includes multiple individually wrapped bars, perfect for sharing or stocking up.

Contains Common Allergens
Includes wheat, soy, and milk; suitable for vegetarians but not for individuals with these allergies. 

Benefits

Supports Digestive Health
Each bar provides a significant fiber boost, making it easier to meet your daily fiber goals.

Smart Sweet Craving Solution
Delivers chocolate flavor with minimal sugar and calories.

On-the-Go Friendly
Individually wrapped and ready to enjoy anywhere—at work, school, or while traveling.

Helps with Portion Control
Pre-packaged servings make it easier to avoid overeating.

Prebiotic Potential
The chicory root fiber may promote the growth of beneficial gut bacteria.
ingredients: Chicory Root Extract, Whole Grain Oats, Semisweet Chocolate (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Corn Syrup, Rice Flour, Whole Grain Barley Flakes, Sugar, Vegetable Glycerin, Canola Oil, Palm Kernel Oil, Maltodextrin, Soy Lecithin, Tricalcium Phosphate, Sugarcane Fiber, Cocoa Powder, Salt, Fructose, Cocoa Processed With Alkali, Barley Malt Extract, Cellulose Gum, Baking Soda, Milk Powder, Natural Flavor, Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Retain Freshness.
